name: The pricing ladder
summary: Delta Fleet's pricing ladder: Daily Brief starter, then Recon audit, then a fixed-price Install, then a Flight Ops retainer.
content:
# The pricing ladder

Affordability at the bottom, moat at the top. The four rungs:

1. **Daily Brief** — $99 setup + $79/month (or $49/month bring-your-own-API-key). A read-only starter agent; setup is credited toward a Recon.
2. **Recon** — a paid workflow audit (~$2k) that produces a fixed-price plan; the fee is credited from the starter setup.
3. **Install** — $8,000–$20,000 fixed, one to three corridors live in 30 days.
4. **Flight Ops** — a managed retainer with a monthly Delta Proof report.

Legacy marketing retainer tiers (Scout / Squadron / Armada) still apply to the marketing corridors.

name: Trust curve & gate relaxation
summary: A gate becomes a relaxation candidate after at least 20 verdicts with under 5% intervention over the trailing 100; two actions never auto-relax.
content:
# Trust curve & gate relaxation

Brand-visible or irreversible actions start behind a human approval gate. A gate becomes a **relaxation candidate** only on measured evidence: at least **20 verdicts** in the trailing window with an intervention rate (edits + rejects) **under 5%**. Relaxations are proposals a human applies — never automatic, always reversible, always ledgered.

**Two actions never auto-relax:** CRM merges and negative-review responses.

The adversarial verification layer strengthens this: a "verified-clean" history earns autonomy faster than raw approvals.

name: The six corridors
summary: The six installable workflows: Speed-to-Lead, Inbox & CRM Hygiene, Reporting Autopilot, Content/AEO Engine, Document Intake, and Review & Reputation, plus the Daily Brief starter.
content:
# The six corridors

A corridor is one installable workflow, fully described by a blueprint. The six:

1. **Speed-to-Lead** — respond to inbound leads in minutes.
2. **Inbox & CRM Hygiene** — triage, label, keep the CRM clean.
3. **Reporting Autopilot** — weekly reports, numbers computed not generated.
4. **Content / AEO Engine** — answer-engine-optimized content.
5. **Document Intake** — invoices and documents matched and posted.
6. **Review & Reputation** — draft public responses to reviews.

Plus the read-only **Daily Brief** starter (inbox + calendar, debriefed every weekday).

name: Deterministic spine, agent joints
summary: Anything that can be plain code IS plain code (zero tokens, reproducible); models are reserved for judgment; numbers in deliverables are computed, never generated.
content:
# Deterministic spine, agent joints

The core execution doctrine. Anything that can be deterministic MUST be a script — plain code, same input same output, zero tokens. The model is reserved for judgment: classify, summarize, draft in brand voice, decide exceptions. **Numbers in client deliverables come from code, never a model** — a computed figure can't be hallucinated. This is what makes the starter tier economically real at cents per run.

name: The memory flywheel
summary: Every human edit or rejection at a gate is captured as per-client memory, so corrections teach the fleet and the same edit is not needed twice.
content:
# The memory flywheel

The key learning moat. Every human `edited` or `rejected` gate verdict is auto-captured as a keyed client memory candidate; repeated corrections confirm (confidence grows) rather than duplicate. Interventions teach the fleet: the trust curve reduces gating over time, and memory reduces the need for edits at all — so the same correction is never needed twice.

name: BYOK — bring your own key
summary: When a client opts in, inference bills to their own Anthropic key via profile.byok, decoupling our margin from their token volume.
content:
# BYOK — bring your own key

Bring-your-own-key: when the client profile opts in (`profile.byok.enabled`), inference bills to the client's own Anthropic key (env-var named in the profile) instead of ours. Their cost at cost, our margin decoupled from their token volume. It drops the Daily Brief starter from $79 to $49/month.
